chapter: Addendum on the Eckstine band arrangers
title: 8 May 1983 session opens: more on the Eckstine band
summary: The interviewer records the date, and Malachi says he wants to add people he under-covered in the Eckstine band.

blocks.x: This is May 8, 1983, at John's house in Washington, D.C., and you had some other things you wanted to say.

Yeah. In talking about the Eckstine band, I mentioned a lot of individuals. In retrospect, I realize that I didn't say enough about some other important people that I could have said some things about.
